public_payload.normalized_proposition: All hyperscalers and neoclouds are struggling to bring AI capacity online.

from_speaker: If Microsoft is struggling, everybody’s struggling
our_interpretation: In context, 'everybody' means hyperscalers and neoclouds building large-scale AI capacity.
The ordinary factual reading is that every operator in that class faces material difficulty bringing planned AI capacity online.

Material difficulty includes significant commissioning delays, power or facility bottlenecks, or equipment waiting for deployable infrastructure. Ordinary construction in progress alone does not establish difficulty.
Use April 1 through June 30, 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter publicly reportable before the post.
The final sentence makes an unconditional observation. The preceding 'if' is an argument for it, not a forecast antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish material AI-capacity deployment difficulties across the full stated class, with adequate operator coverage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish at least one operator in the stated class whose material AI deployment program proceeded without such difficulties during the target period. A single successful project alone is insufficient.
